title: Private 9-11-2001 (September 11th) Memorial and Ground Zero Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Even if you've toured this area before, if you haven't done it with a guide, you haven't done it. We are one of the top ranked and requested guide companies in the world for this tour.  Each guide is hand selected for their connections to these events.  

Hear gripping stories, learn WHY each detail was chosen and fully understand the impact of this tragedy, and the growth since.  

A respectful and honorable walking tour of the memorial grounds and surrounding areas, laced with moving and personal stories told by a New Yorker who lived in New York or the surrounding area on the day of the event.
